benchmarkDeferral.reason: Jonathan approved deferring fresh performance comparisons for Waves 1.7.4 build 22. The release Mac was under heavy unrelated load, so measurements taken then would not be meaningful. The only render-path change since 1.7.3 is one finite-value check in level metering.

releaseDeferral.reason: Jonathan approved publishing Waves 1.7.4 build 22 with the macOS 15 runtime test and the hands-on Stream Deck and device matrix deferred. No macOS 15 Mac is available. He reported Wave Link control working on his own hardware with Waves 1.7.3; the 1.7.4 build was not run against Wave Link before publication. Local runtime, companion protocol, signing and package checks remain required.
